reservationRule: Before a cell starts, reserve one ordinary full closure, five compact passing repeats, and one exceptional full closure. Stop before either the cell reservation or cumulative ceiling would be exceeded.
ordinaryRule: The first successfully completed measured attempt retains the ordinary full closure.
compactRule: A warmup or other passing measured repeat becomes compact only after that attempt independently completes every required semantic validation; it binds the exact semantic summary, probe, decoded identity hashes, and output hash without claiming encoded-byte equality.
exceptionalRule: Every failed, blocked, cancelled, or integrity-exception attempt retains a complete closure.
limitations: This is a Gate 0 evidence-retention contract only.
It does not authorize media execution, R2 access, product behavior, a shipping runtime, distribution, or legal conclusions.
